name: Michelson
typeSystem: Static and strongly typed stack-based language: every instruction has a precise, statically checked effect on the shape and types of the stack, so a Michelson contract cannot even be deployed unless it type-checks completely.
runtime: Executed directly by the Tezos blockchain's node software as the low-level target that higher-level languages (e.g. LIGO, SmartPy) compile down to; there is no separate bytecode format beneath it.

runtimes.name: Tezos node interpreter
runtimes.role: Every Tezos node type-checks and interprets Michelson instructions directly when executing a smart contract.

compilers.name: LIGO / SmartPy (higher-level front ends)
compilers.role: Higher-level languages that compile down to Michelson, which developers rarely write by hand.

concurrencyModel: N/A: each contract call executes atomically and sequentially as part of a single Tezos operation.

codeExample.caption: A contract that always returns a greeting string
